Fixes the E5108 crash: vim.json.decode maps JSON null ("constraints":null, "suggested_target":null from the plugin) to cjson's null userdata — truthy, so the `if field then` guards passed and concatenation crashed. Decodes now pass { luanil = { object = true, array = true } } → null becomes nil → guards work. set_status deliberately decodes without the option so queue lines stay byte-stable.

Defense in depth: all rendered fields now go through s()/join() coercion, so no userdata/table/number can crash concatenation in render_previews/render_list. Same group as the registry.lua nullfix so both fixes review together.

Fixes E5108 "attempt to call global 'refresh_items'": kill_viewer + refresh_items are now defined BEFORE merge_current/reject_current (their callers), matching reviewview's documented ordering constraint. Comment added so future edits don't reintroduce the trap.
